text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a short access snapshot for the infra and data-prod groups today. Aim: find admin overlaps, stale grants, and any ownerless roles. Will post CSV when done.
Carlos Rivera: ETA?
Maya Chen: by EOD PST. Running `./tools/iam-query --org redwood --groups infra,data-prod --format csv` and pulling KMS bindings too.
Nate Brooks: Please include cross-project KMS grants — last sweep missed a few.
Samir Patel: Suggest we auto-create remediation tickets and set `justification_age` so we can sort by outdated approvals. /remediate-bot could handle assignation.
Elle Johnson: Small question: do we treat workload-identity service accounts with project-level editor as "elevated"?
Maya Chen: Yes — any SA with project roles/editor or roles/owner on prod projects will be marked `elevated`. We'll flag workload identity separately.
sec-automation-bot: scan started for groups infra,data-prod. estimated 12m.
Carlos Rivera: If we find ownerless admin roles, what's the playbook? create ticket + 72h SLA? temporary removal?
Maya Chen: Proposed playbook: 1) create ticket, assign team:security, owner:unassigned 2) notify ownerless-admins queue 3) 72h review window 4) if no response, temp-remove and monitor 24h 5) escalate to sec-oncall if breakage. Ack?
Carlos Rivera: ack
Nate Brooks: Also attach auditlog snapshot links to each ticket so owners can see recent activity: https://logs.redwood.internal/access/1699999999
Maya Chen: Will attach redacted auditlink + CSV. Also adding a `risk_reason` column for quick triage.
Samir Patel: I'll draft a safe rollback snippet for removals: `iam-grant --id $ticket --principal $principal --role $role --reason "revert temp-prune"` and include step-by-step in the runbook.
Maya Chen: good idea. tagging sec-oncall @Elle Johnson for FYI
Elle Johnson: reading. I can cover triage windows if anything spikes during the sweep.
Maya Chen: initial snapshot posted: https://files.redwood/priv-snapshots/1699999999.csv :lock:
Carlos Rivera: scanning now — found 3 svcacct with ownerless owner role on prod-analytics and 1 cross-project KMS grant to external-project.
Nate Brooks: filing tickets for the ownerless ones. I'll include proposed mitigation and risk window in the ticket description.
Maya Chen: leaving pinned checklist in the ticket template: 1) confirm owner or team 2) open ticket 3) 72h review 4) temp-remove if no response 5) monitor 24h and reopen if any failed jobs
Samir Patel: Any objections to running a low-blast-radius canary prune next week (subset of principals) to validate the playbook?
Elle Johnson: +1 to canary
Maya Chen: scheduling canary prune Tue 08:00 UTC. will notify infra, analytics, and oncall.
sec-automation-bot: scan complete. results summary: 42 elevated principals, 3 ownerless admin bindings, 12 stale grants (older than 180d). CSV and tickets attached to thread.
Carlos Rivera: note for tickets: add KMS rotation team when grant involves key-handling roles.
Maya Chen: added KMS rotation as required watcher on relevant tickets. thanks all :pray:
